source.test: backupWorld(for:) filename construction and pruneAutoBackupsIfNeeded managed-file filter

notes: The doc comment at line 836 states this directly: pre-replace backups "intentionally have no `_auto_` or `_manual_` token so they are not pruned." pruneAutoBackupsIfNeeded's managedFiles filter (lines 544-548) requires `.contains(autoBackupToken) || .contains(manualBackupToken)`; a pre-replace backup fails both, so it is invisible to both the pre-backup auto-prune step and the manual "Prune Old Backups" button no matter its age. Contrast with restoreBackup's own safety backup, which calls the ordinary createBackup(isAutomatic: false, ...) path and DOES get the `_manual_` token -- see fixtures/backup-restore/restore-creates-mandatory-safety-backup-before-any-restore-mutation.
